parameters.jsCode:
const campaign = $input.first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    campaignName: campaign.property_campaign_name || campaign.name,
    campaignId: campaign.property_campaign_id || campaign.id,
    pageId: campaign.id,

    status: campaign.property_status,
    campaignStatus: campaign.property_campaign_status,
    campaignType: campaign.property_campaign_type,
    language: campaign.property_language || 'English',

    targetSector: campaign.property_target_sector || [],
    targetCity: campaign.property_target_city || [],

    subjectLine: campaign.property_subject_line,
    emailContent: campaign.property_email_content,
    cta: campaign.property_cta,

    emailsSent: campaign.property_emails_sent || 0,
    replies: campaign.property_replies || 0,
    meetingsBooked: campaign.property_meetings_booked || 0,
    dailyLimit: campaign.property_daily_limit || 10,

    headerLogoUrl: campaign.property_header_logo_url,
    bannerImageUrl: campaign.property_banner_image_url,
    ctaUrl: campaign.property_cta_url,
    ctaTextArabic: campaign.property_cta_text_arabic,
    ctaTextEnglish: campaign.property_cta_text_english,
    footerArabic: campaign.property_footer_arabic,
    footerEnglish: campaign.property_footer_english,
    supportEmail: campaign.property_support_email,
    primaryPhone: campaign.property_primary_phone,
    secondaryPhone: campaign.property_secondary_phone,
    thirdPhone: campaign.property_third_phone,
    linkedInUrl: campaign.property_linked_in_url,
    instagramUrl: campaign.property_instagram_url,
    facebookUrl: campaign.property_facebook_url,
    brandPrimaryColor: campaign.property_brand_primary_color || '#08145F',
    brandSecondaryColor: campaign.property_brand_secondary_color || '#FFFFFF',
    subjectArabic: campaign.property_subject_arabic,
    subjectEnglish: campaign.property_subject_english,
    emailContentArabic: campaign.property_email_content_arabic,
    emailContentEnglish: campaign.property_email_content_english
  }
}];
